guarantees.claim: When op_i equals CIPH_FWD, in_data_basis_x is assigned aes_mvm(data_i, A2X); when op_i equals CIPH_INV, it is assigned aes_mvm(data_i ^ 8'h63, S2X); otherwise it falls back to aes_mvm(data_i, A2X).

When op_i equals CIPH_FWD, in_mask_basis_x is assigned aes_mvm(mask_i, A2X); when op_i equals CIPH_INV, it is assigned aes_mvm(mask_i, S2X); otherwise it falls back to aes_mvm(mask_i, A2X). The addition of constant 8'h63 is deliberately omitted.

assumptions.claim: The signal op_i is driven exclusively with values CIPH_FWD or CIPH_INV; any other value will trigger the default fallback, which may not correspond to the intended cipher direction.
assumptions.cond: When operating in a context that requires correct cipher direction.
assumptions.risk: Using the fallback could cause wrong basis conversion, leading to incorrect AES S‑box output and potential data corruption or security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: The mask conversion (in_mask_basis_x) skips the addition of 8’h63 that is applied to data_i during inverse operation. The surrounding DOM S‑box logic must be consistent with this absence; otherwise the mask may be misaligned with the masked data, potentially revealing mask bits.
uncertain_points.cond: In CIPH_INV mode, if the consuming logic expects mask to include the constant offset.
uncertain_points.risk: Mask leakage or incorrect masked inversion that breaks side‑channel resistance.

uncertain_points.claim: If op_i takes an illegal value (neither CIPH_FWD nor CIPH_INV), the default branch silently selects the forward conversion. No error indication is generated.
uncertain_points.cond: A glitch, misconfiguration, or fault injects an illegal op_i value.
uncertain_points.risk: Undetected incorrect cipher direction could corrupt data or mask without alarm, possibly aiding fault attacks.
